replacement_proofs.method: Each individual two-B word is bounded below by the same spectral target, using symmetric weights and paired AM-GM; complete counting and normalization then give the average inequality.
replacement_proofs.not_individually_formalized: The uniform gap-average identity (3.5); it is not a dependency of the proved proposition.

replacement_proofs.method: Evenness gives derivative zero at the disk center; the Mobius transform has the same symmetry. The proved second-order Schwarz lemma gives the norm-squared point bound directly.
replacement_proofs.not_individually_formalized: The auxiliary quotient H(w^2); it is not needed by this replacement proof.

replacement_proofs.method: Matching first derivatives at the identity make the one-step difference o(t). Local norm bounds 1+C*|t| and a noncommuting power-difference estimate give a vanishing k-step error. The comparison exponential has an exactly known k-th power.
replacement_proofs.not_individually_formalized: The original O(k^-2) matrix-log series expansion and agreement of that series with the spectral log; they are not dependencies of the proved bridge.

formalized_alt_scope.proved_parameter_ranges: q is any positive integer; r=n/q for any natural n>=q. In particular r=k for arbitrary positive integers k,q, and all low-degree instances used in Sections 3,4,7.
formalized_alt_scope.unformalized_background_statement: The full background inequality (3.1) quantified over arbitrary real r>=1 and real q>0 is not separately formalized and is not assumed by the completed application proofs.

coverage_interpretation: Strict statement-by-statement manuscript coverage, including the full real-parameter background ALT and the unused intermediates of replaced proofs, is not claimed. All required main conclusions and their dependencies are proved.

background_statements_not_fully_formaliz.statement: Full ALT with arbitrary real r>=1 and real q>0
